description: This Java class 'EntityAutoEngine' implements a generic service engine for handling CRUD operations (create, update, delete, expire) on entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to run these operations based on service invocation parameters, employing various utility classes and enforcing security checks. The class is designed to facilitate automated entity management in a service-oriented architecture, encapsulating the logic for entity creation, update, deletion, and expiration with support for primary key handling and status management.

classes.name: EntityAutoEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine, implementing a service engine for CRUD operations on entities with security and consistency checks.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides the method to run the service synchronously while ignoring errors, delegating to runSync.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Main method executing the entity management logic based on the invoke action (create, update, delete, expire) with validation, PK handling, and error management.

methods.name: invokeCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of new entity instances, managing primary key generation, default fields, and security checks.

methods.name: invokeUpdate
methods.description: Performs update operations on existing entities, ensuring PK validity and data integrity.

methods.name: invokeDelete
methods.description: Performs deletion of entities based on primary keys, with security validation.

methods.name: invokeExpire
methods.description: Sets expiration dates or related timestamp fields on entities, often used for soft deletes or status transitions.

methods.name: isValidText
methods.description: Checks the validity of provided text parameters for security purposes, mainly for file upload paths.
